serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Ah man! I’m broke too!
Hobo: You think I will believe that? You smell like soap! 
Damn, his senses are sharp!
You: Oh, come on! Soap isn’t that expensive, you know?
He should probably try it sometime, but I can’t say it at loud.
Hobo: Hmmm…{{wi}} I just felt insulted for some reason, I don’t know why…
You: A-anyway, I gotta go man. Good luck with… whatever you are up to.
Hobo: No! I don’t think so!
Hobo: You don’t get how desperate I really am to get some money!
Hobo: But soon…{{wi}} you will realise…
Hobo: Argh!
#Hobo.Face.angry
